name: strategy-labs-plugins
description: Official plugin marketplace from Strategy Labs — boutique performance marketing tools for eCommerce and lead generation brands.

plugins.name: analytics-setup
plugins.description: Analytics and Data Setup Wizard — connects Meta, Google Ads, GA4, Klaviyo, and Shopify, audits historical performance, identifies tracking gaps, and establishes the benchmarks used by every agent in the system. Run once at setup, refresh quarterly.

plugins.name: brand-intelligence-center
plugins.description: Brand Intelligence Center — a choice-driven setup wizard that builds a complete brand profile combining operational depth with conversion intelligence. The single source of truth for all Strategy Labs marketing plugins.

plugins.name: campaign-strategist
plugins.description: Campaign Strategist — the top-level marketing campaign orchestrator. Takes a goal and produces a complete campaign brief, then coordinates the Creative Director, Art Director, and Performance Marketing agents in parallel.

plugins.name: creative-director
plugins.description: Creative Director — translates campaign briefs into creative concepts and coordinates all copywriting specialists in parallel. Owns the creative concept, campaign line, and hook angles.

plugins.name: art-director
plugins.description: Art Director — creates visual direction systems for campaigns and reviews design executions. Produces visual direction documents and briefs for all design specialists.

plugins.name: marketing-analytics
plugins.description: Marketing Analytics — a team of four specialist analysts (Campaign Performance, Channel Mix, Creative Performance, Revenue/ROI) that review marketing data and produce structured briefs for the Campaign Strategist, Performance Marketing, and Creative Director.

plugins.name: performance-marketing
plugins.description: Performance Marketing Agent — builds media plans, platform campaign setup documents, and UTM/tracking infrastructure for Meta, Google, Email, LinkedIn, and TikTok. Manages the optimization loop using data from Marketing Analytics.

plugins.name: ad-copy
plugins.description: Ad Copywriter — writes paid advertising copy for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google RSA, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Pinterest. Checks the content library for existing approved copy before writing new variants.

plugins.name: email-copy
plugins.description: Email Copywriter — writes marketing email sequences: welcome series, promotional campaigns, abandoned cart, nurture flows, re-engagement, and cold outreach. Checks the content library before writing new copy.

plugins.name: direct-response-copy
plugins.description: Direct Response Copywriter — writes landing pages, sales pages, and VSL scripts using Schwartz awareness levels and proven persuasion architecture. Checks the content library before writing new copy.

plugins.name: brand-storytelling-copy
plugins.description: Brand Storytelling Copywriter — writes brand narrative content: about pages, founder stories, manifestos, mission/vision/values, and thought leadership essays. Checks the content library before writing new copy.

plugins.name: seo-copy
plugins.description: SEO Copywriter — writes search-optimized content by analyzing SERP competition, classifying search intent, and building content architecture. Covers blog posts, pillar pages, comparison pages, and programmatic templates.

plugins.name: graphic-design
plugins.description: Graphic Design Agent — produces digital ad creative through three paths: detailed Canva direction, AI image generation prompts, or design specification documents for human designers.

plugins.name: ux-website-designer
plugins.description: UX and Website Designer — produces wireframe documents, UX copy (form labels, error messages, microcopy), CRO hypotheses, responsive design notes, and accessibility requirements for landing pages and web experiences.

plugins.name: print-design
plugins.description: Print Design Agent — creates print production specifications with CMYK/Pantone color values, bleed and trim setup, ink density limits, and pre-production checklists for magazines, newspapers, direct mail, and brochures.

plugins.name: ooh-design
plugins.description: OOH Design Agent — creates out-of-home advertising design specifications for billboards, urban posters, bus shelters, subway ads, transit, and digital OOH. Enforces word limits by format and viewing-distance legibility standards.

plugins.name: packaging-brand-design
plugins.description: Packaging and Brand Design Agent — produces design specifications for product packaging, trade show displays, corporate identity (business cards, letterhead), and presentation templates.

plugins.name: retail-design
plugins.description: Retail Design Agent — designs merchandise and retail products: apparel, stickers, drinkware, patches, pins, and tote bags. Covers screen printing, DTG, embroidery, sublimation, and vinyl cutting with POD platform guidance.

plugins.name: pr-influencer
plugins.description: PR and Influencer Agent — plans earned media campaigns including influencer partnerships, press releases, media pitches, brand ambassador programs, and UGC strategies. Produces creator briefs and FTC compliance checklists.

plugins.name: video-content-strategy
plugins.description: Video Content Strategist — plans and scripts video content across all formats: YouTube channel strategy, TikTok and Instagram Reels content plans, video ad scripts, and content calendars.

plugins.name: cro-orchestrator
plugins.description: CRO Orchestrator — identifies, prioritizes, and tests changes that increase conversion rates across the marketing funnel. Produces funnel audits, ICE-scored A/B test hypotheses, and checkout optimization plans.

plugins.name: best-practices
plugins.description: Best Practices Updater — crawls official platform documentation from Meta, Google, Klaviyo, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Pinterest to surface changes that should be reflected in agent reference files. Produces structured update reports with before/after text.

plugins.name: content-library
plugins.description: Content Library — the indexed backlog of all approved marketing copy and the searchable catalogue of brand visual assets. Surfaces existing approved copy before new copy is written. Prompts for approval and storage after every copy session.

plugins.name: brand-content-os
plugins.description: Brand & Content Operating System — capture brand knowledge, enforce voice consistency, and generate on-brand content across paid ads, email, SMS, Shopify, and social channels.

plugins.name: customer-driven-optimizations
plugins.description: Analyze recorded customer phone calls to extract competitive intelligence, identify site optimization opportunities, map customer journeys, and generate a deployable HTML dashboard.

plugins.name: competitive-landscape
plugins.description: Track competitors, analyze their ad strategies across Meta and Google, map customer journeys on competitor sites, and generate competitive intelligence reports and deployable dashboards.

plugins.name: local-business-marketing-os
plugins.description: Full marketing operating system for local restaurants and hospitality businesses. Includes brand onboarding, review responses, email/SMS campaigns, and weekly social content briefs.

plugins.name: brand-knowledge-center
plugins.description: Brand Knowledge Center — a step-by-step setup wizard that builds a comprehensive brand profile covering business fundamentals, financials, digital presence, brand identity, audience messaging, and competitive landscape.

plugins.name: brand-asset-manager
plugins.description: Brand Asset Manager — organize, rename, describe, and catalog brand photos and videos into a searchable folder structure. Analyzes each asset, generates descriptions, suggests channel usage, and maintains a searchable manifest.

plugins.name: lead-list-builder
plugins.description: Lead List Builder — complete lead generation and pipeline management system. Research leads, draft personalized outreach, track status, deploy interactive dashboards, and manage daily/weekly/monthly workflow.

plugins.name: inbox-command-center
plugins.description: Inbox Command Center — AI communications manager that triages Gmail, Slack, iMessage, and messaging platforms. Auto-categorizes messages, drafts replies in your authentic voice, manages calendar conflicts, and delivers scheduled daily briefings.

plugins.name: cfo-agent
plugins.description: Fractional CFO Agent — operates as a trusted financial partner across multiple brand engagements. Loads brand-specific financial context and executes CFO work: P&L analysis, EBITDA normalization, deal structuring, SBA underwriting, investor/lender packages, KPI dashboards, and strategic financial advisory. Supports three active engagements: The Great PNW (DTC e-commerce), Uno Mas (restaurant), Strategy Labs (digital agency).

plugins.name: mail-agent
plugins.description: Physical Mail Agent — reads scanned or photographed mail dropped into a folder, classifies each piece, extracts key details (amounts, deadlines, reference numbers), assesses urgency, determines routing, and tells you exactly what to do with every letter. Supports Slack and email routing to designated contacts.
